responsibility: Implements tree-streaming utilities shared by LTO input and output. It maintains the streamer tree cache and mode-translation table, verifies that all TS_* tree storage variants are covered by streaming support, preloads and records well-known common tree nodes so they need not be redundantly serialized, and provides cache insertion, lookup, replacement, and lifecycle helpers that coordinate how tree nodes are indexed and merged across tree-streamer-in.c and tree-streamer-out.c.
same_name_distinction: Implements shared tree-streaming support code used by LTO readers and writers, especially cache creation/lookup/replacement, common-node preloading, mode-table handling, and streamer consistency checks. Unlike gcc/tree-streamer.h, which declares the cache/data structures and reader-writer interfaces, this file supplies the shared implementation.
